faqs.q: What is the difference between Hajj and Umrah?
faqs.a: Hajj is the obligatory pilgrimage every able Muslim must perform once in their lifetime, on specific days of Dhu'l-Hijjah. Umrah is a non-obligatory pilgrimage that can be performed any time of year. From Pakistan, Umrah trips typically last 10–14 days; Hajj trips run 25–40 days because of the multi-stage rites.

A valid passport with at least 6 months of validity, recent passport-size photos, an NIC copy, and proof of travel (we provide this from our booking). For Hajj you also need to be vaccinated for meningitis (we coordinate this with you). Children require their own passports and NICs.

For Umrah, 2–4 weeks before your travel date is comfortable. For Hajj, book as early as possible — 6+ months ideally — because the Saudi government allocates limited Hajj visa quotas per country and good hotel inventory near the Haram books out fast.

Yes. We tailor hotel categories, room types, and Ziyarat pacing for families of any size — couples, parents with adult children, and multi-generational groups. Tell your Regional Representative your group composition and we'll quote accordingly.

faqs.q: Which countries do you handle student visas for?
faqs.a: UK, USA, Canada, Australia primarily — plus Germany, France, Ireland, New Zealand, and Malaysia as commonly requested. Tell us your university acceptance and destination and we'll confirm what's needed.

faqs.q: How long does the application take?
faqs.a: From document preparation to decision: typically 4–8 weeks depending on the country and the embassy's processing time. UK and Canada are usually faster; USA varies by consulate. Start early — at least 8 weeks before your intake.

No agent can guarantee visa approval — the decision rests with the embassy. What we guarantee is a complete, error-free application with all supporting documentation in the right format. A well-prepared application has a significantly higher approval rate.

At minimum: valid passport, university acceptance letter (CAS / I-20 / LOA), financial proof, academic transcripts, English-language test results (IELTS/TOEFL/PTE), and police clearance certificate. Exact list varies by country — your Regional Representative will give you a custom checklist.

faqs.a: Most destinations require one when visiting family — UK, Schengen, USA, Canada all do. Your host abroad sends the invitation along with proof of their status (visa, citizenship) and address. We tell you exactly what's needed.

GAMCA (Gulf Approved Medical Centres Association) is the network of medical centres approved by GCC governments to conduct pre-departure health checks. Required for all work visas. We help you book at the nearest GAMCA-approved centre in Pakistan.

faqs.q: How long does the process take?
faqs.a: From job offer to visa-in-hand: typically 4–8 weeks. The slowest steps are document attestation and medical clearance. We run them in parallel to compress the timeline.

faqs.q: Do you find me a job?
faqs.a: No — we are a visa-processing agency, not a recruiter. You need an existing job offer from a Gulf employer to start the visa process. Once you have it, we handle everything else.
